name: Mammoth
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
publisher: Open Design LLC d/b/a Kobold Press
pageNumbering: Printed folio and one-based page number agree.
hitDiceEvidence: Fixed HP. No Hit Dice formula appears in this printing.
appearanceSource: The Black Flag block gives the name and Huge size. The detailed woolly mammoth body, coat and tusks are editorial natural-history cues, shared with the 2014 portrait.
habitatSource: Cold steppe and tundra are editorial tags based on woolly mammoth habitat and the native block’s cold resistance.
sourceDistinctions: The source prints both cold and prone under Resistant. The prone entry is condition resistance under p. 232.
CR 6 is worth 2,300 XP under the native table. Use the printed Gore and Stomp numbers, even though the 2014 block assigns different bonuses and dice.

name: Mammoth
appearanceSource: The p. 332 description gives thick fur, long tusks and a stocky elephantine build. The domed head, coat color and illustration are editorial.
habitatSource: The p. 332 description gives a range of climates from subarctic to subtropical. Cold steppe and tundra are editorial tags for cold habitats.
sourceDistinctions: Read the first-printing stat block on p. 332 and checked the 2014 D&D Beyond listing. The official Monster Manual errata has no Mammoth-specific adjustment.

name: Tiger
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
publisher: Open Design LLC d/b/a Kobold Press
pageNumbering: Printed folio and one-based page number agree.
hitDiceEvidence: Fixed HP. No Hit Dice formula appears in this printing.
